# Commodity (`commodity` v1)

A traded commodity with its benchmark, unit and venue.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `CMD` · **Identifiers:** `CMD-…` in `commodityId`

Open one with `CMD <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: commodity
version: 1
description: "A traded commodity with its benchmark, unit and venue."
match: { kind: commodity, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Commodity, id: $.commodityId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Front month, bind: $.front, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Unit, bind: $.unit }
  - { label: Exchange, bind: $.exchange }
  - { label: Sector, bind: $.sector }
panels:
  - id: spec
    kind: kv
    title: Contract specification
    key: F2
    rows: $.spec
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.commodityCurve, 'commodity-curve')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
